evals.name: tracked-config-cites-key-and-file
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-context

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. landscape_dialect is absent, so the mermaid default applies. The subject is a git checkout whose tracked src/appsettings.json has ConnectionStrings.Orders set to a SQL connection string with an embedded password, Partner.BaseUrl set to an https URL with userinfo and a sig query, and Auth.ClientSecret set to a secret. No context.json exists yet. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-context.sh and render-context.sh. Writes docs/architecture/context.json and context.md. The SQL external cites src/appsettings.json and ConnectionStrings.Orders. The partner host cites Partner.BaseUrl. The password, userinfo, query signature, and client secret appear nowhere in the record, the diagram, or the report. Actors is empty.
expectations: Runs ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/collect-context.sh against the subject repository rather than grepping config and composing JSON by hand
Writes context.json before rendering, then runs render-context.sh --dialect mermaid to produce context.md
The SQL row is origin derived and its file and key are src/appsettings.json and ConnectionStrings.Orders
The partner row cites Partner.BaseUrl and keeps only the host
No password, userinfo, query signature, or ClientSecret value is present in context.json, context.md, or the closing report
Does not pass --actors, and the closing report says actors=0

evals.name: operator-actors-render-differently
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-context

architecture_dir is docs/architecture and landscape_dialect is mermaid. Tracked config names one external host. The operator, asked who uses the system, answered only: Clerk, who files a claim. Nobody else was named.
evals.expected_output: context.md draws Clerk as a Person and the external host as a System_Ext. The node table says operator-stated for Clerk and derived for the external system. No other person appears.
expectations: Passes --actors with a file that contains only the operator-stated Clerk row
The actor row origin is operator and the external row origin is derived
context.md contains Person( for Clerk and System_Ext( for the external host
The node table contains operator-stated and derived
Does not add a person from CODEOWNERS, git history, or a README

evals.name: non-interactive-emits-no-actors
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-context

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. This is a non-interactive run. CODEOWNERS names @alice and the README says the system is maintained by Bob. Tracked appsettings.json names one external host.
evals.expected_output: No actors are emitted. The record has an empty actors array. context.md has no Person element. Alice and Bob are not nodes.
expectations: Does not pass --actors
The actors array is empty
context.md does not contain Person(
Neither alice nor Bob appears as a node
The closing report says actors=0

evals.name: thin-result-names-neighboring-rungs

/architecture:map-context

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The only tracked config is an appsettings.json whose Url is http://localhost:5000 and whose other keys are log levels. This is a non-interactive run.

context.md contains the sentence No external systems were found in committed configuration.
context.md names /architecture:map-landscape
context.md names containers (the deployables inside this system)
context.md still contains System( for the focal system
Does not invent an external system to avoid a thin result

evals.name: no-home-stops

The resolver exits 1. There is no --out argument. This is a non-interactive run. The repository has tracked connection strings.

Points at /architecture:setup
Does not choose a directory because the repository contains config files

evals.name: structurizr-reuses-landscape-dialect
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-context billing

architecture_dir is docs/architecture and the topic doc declares landscape_dialect: structurizr. Tracked config names one external host. The operator stated one actor, Clerk. Do not consult diagram_dialect.system.
evals.expected_output: Renders context.dsl with a systemContext view, a person element for Clerk, and an External tag on the derived system. Does not write context.md. The focal name is billing.

Does not read diagram_dialect.system and does not add a new dialect key
context.dsl contains systemContext, = person , and External
context.dsl gives the operator element shape Person
Does not write context.md
Passes --focal billing

evals.name: config-is-matched-never-executed
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-context

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. A tracked web.config value is https://hooks.example.com/$(touch SHOULD_NOT_RUN) under the key Hooks.BaseUrl. A gitignored .env contains a URL whose userinfo is a secret. An untracked JSON file names another host.
evals.expected_output: The hooks host is recorded from the tracked key. The shell substitution is not executed. The gitignored secret and the untracked host are absent from the record and the report.
expectations: The external row cites Hooks.BaseUrl and the host hooks.example.com
Does not execute the value, so SHOULD_NOT_RUN is never created
The gitignored secret does not appear in context.json, the diagram, or the report
The untracked host is not a node
Must not echo the raw connection value while explaining the redaction
